description: End-to-end customer support ticket lifecycle orchestrated via a CPaaS email API, including email ingestion, ticket creation, routing, replies, status updates, and error handling.

ticket_id.description: Unique identifier for a support ticket

thread_id.description: Identifier linking related email messages in a conversation

message_id.description: Unique identifier for an email message

customer_id.description: Identifier of the end-customer in the support system

agent_id.description: Identifier of the support agent or queue

ticket_status.description: Lifecycle status of the support ticket

functions.name: ingest_incoming_email
functions.description: Ingest an incoming email from the CPaaS/email gateway and normalize it into a support-ready structure. May create a new thread or attach to an existing one based on headers.

raw_email.description: Raw email content and metadata as received from CPaaS

received_at.description: Timestamp when the email was received

lookback_minutes.description: Window to check for duplicates if strategy is not 'none'

subject_normalization.description: Strip prefixes like Re:, Fwd: for thread detection

functions.returns: Normalized email entity with detected or new thread_id, message_id, candidate customer_id, and flags indicating if this likely starts a new ticket.

functions.name: auto_classify_and_route
functions.description: Classify an ingested email into categories, determine priority, and suggest routing to a support queue or agent.

language_hint.description: Optional language code (e.g. en, fr, es)

default_queue.description: Fallback queue if no specific rule matches

language_queues.description: Map of language code to queue ID

functions.returns: Classification result including categories, detected language, suggested priority, and suggested agent_id or queue_id.

functions.name: create_or_update_ticket_from_email
functions.description: Create a new support ticket or update an existing one based on an email thread and classification result.

ticket_linking.description: Options and hints for linking to existing tickets

existing_ticket_id.description: Force linking to this ticket if provided

initial_ticket_fields.description: Optional initial fields when creating a new ticket

functions.returns: Ticket entity including ticket_id, whether it was newly created or updated, and link between thread_id and ticket_id.

functions.name: get_ticket
functions.description: Retrieve a ticket with its current state, associated email thread summary, and latest messages.

messages_pagination.description: Pagination options for messages if included

functions.returns: Complete ticket details including ticket fields, status, assigned agent, and optionally related emails/messages.

functions.name: update_ticket_properties
functions.description: Update ticket properties such as status, priority, assignment, tags, and custom fields.

updates.description: Fields to update on the ticket

update_reason.description: Reason for the update, stored in audit log

functions.returns: Updated ticket state with new properties and a reference to the audit log entry for this update.

functions.name: send_ticket_reply_email
functions.description: Send an outbound email reply associated with a ticket and thread, optionally including attachments and CC/BCC recipients.

reply_to_message_id.description: Message being replied to; used to set In-Reply-To and References

signature_id.description: Optional ID of a saved agent or team signature to append

attachments.description: Attachments to be included in the reply

storage_ref.description: Reference/URL or blob ID where file is stored

content_id.description: Content ID for inline attachments, used in HTML body

schedule_send_at.description: Optional future time to send the email

functions.returns: Outbound email send result including new message_id, updated thread_id if changed, and delivery tracking identifiers.

functions.name: list_ticket_messages
functions.description: List messages (emails and internal notes) associated with a ticket in chronological or reverse-chronological order.

contains_text.description: Filter messages containing this text snippet

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching next page

functions.returns: List of messages with message_id, direction, timestamps, snippet of content, and pagination cursor for next page.

functions.name: get_ticket_status_and_sla
functions.description: Retrieve the current status, SLA information, and key timing metrics for a ticket.

include_timeline.description: If true, include a timeline of major status changes

functions.returns: Ticket status summary including current status, priority, SLA policy, time to first response, time to resolution, and whether SLA is breached or at risk.

functions.name: retry_email_delivery
functions.description: Retry delivery of a previously failed outbound email associated with a ticket, optionally modifying certain fields before retry.

message_id.description: Identifier of the failed outbound message

override_recipients.description: Optional recipient overrides for the retry

override_content.description: Optional content overrides for the retry

functions.returns: Retry job result including new delivery attempt IDs, next scheduled attempt if any, and final status if immediate retry is attempted.

functions.name: escalate_or_reassign_ticket
functions.description: Escalate a ticket to a higher support tier or reassign it to a different queue or agent with optional notification via email.

escalation.description: Details of the escalation or reassignment

functions.returns: Updated ticket assignment and escalation metadata, plus notification send results if email notifications were triggered.

functions.name: resolve_or_close_ticket
functions.description: Mark a ticket as resolved or closed, optionally sending a resolution email and capturing resolution metrics.

public_notes.description: Optional public note to attach to the ticket

email_options.description: Options for the resolution email when send_resolution_email is true

body_template_id.description: Template ID to render resolution email

functions.returns: Final ticket state, including updated status, resolution metadata, and resolution email send result if applicable.

functions.name: cancel_or_rollback_ticket_changes
functions.description: Rollback recent ticket changes or cancel a ticket closure, restoring a previous state snapshot.

reason.description: Reason for rollback, added to audit log

preserve_new_messages.description: If true, keep messages added after the snapshot

functions.returns: Ticket state after rollback, including snapshot metadata and which changes were reverted.

functions.name: search_tickets
functions.description: Search for tickets based on email attributes, status, customer metadata, and full-text query.

query.description: Full-text search query across subject, body, and notes

functions.returns: Paged list of tickets matching the search criteria, including summary fields and pagination metadata (total, page, page_size).

functions.name: bulk_import_tickets
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple tickets from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined tickets, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_tickets
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of tickets matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped tickets with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_tickets
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of tickets with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_tickets
functions.description: Export a filtered set of tickets to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_tickets_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across tickets with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with tickets hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_ticket_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on ticket lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_ticket_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing ticket subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_ticket_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a ticket subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_ticket_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single ticket with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across tickets for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_ticket_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of tickets.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_ticket_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to tickets with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of ticket jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_ticket_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight ticket job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_ticket_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a ticket (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_ticket_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive ticket change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_ticket_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a ticket approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_ticket_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a ticket, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_ticket_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a ticket, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_ticket
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a ticket for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_ticket_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a ticket from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_ticket_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over tickets (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched tickets.

functions.name: build_ticket_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over tickets data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_ticket_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern ticket behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_ticket_policies
functions.description: List policies governing tickets with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_ticket_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a ticket and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.
